issues.description: Solution groups by the aggregate alias 'Anzahl' instead of grouping by the gemeindeschluessel (the column that identifies each Gemeinde). The problem explicitly asks for the number of Wanderwege per Gemeinde (gemeindeschluessel) and to sort descending by that Anzahl. GROUP BY Anzahl in the provided solution_repository/aufgabe10.sql is structurally incorrect and will either be invalid SQL or produce incorrect/meaningless results — it contradicts the problem specification and would confuse or mislead students about how to aggregate by entity keys.
issues.suggested_fix:
In the solution, group by the gemeindeschluessel (the identifier for each municipality) rather than by the aggregate alias. For example:
SELECT gemeindeschluessel, COUNT(*) AS Anzahl
FROM Wanderweg_zu_Gemeinde
GROUP BY gemeindeschluessel
ORDER BY Anzahl DESC
This aligns the solution with the problem statement and yields the intended per-Gemeinde counts sorted descending.
